newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Brett Kebble resigns from Randgold board.
newsitem.headline: Brett Kebble resigns from Randgold board.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Thursday that Brett Kebble had resigned from the Randgold board following his appointment as an executive director of JCI Ltd.
JCI announced on Tuesday that Kebble had joined as an executive director and had also been appointed chairman of its Western Areas Gold Mining Co Ltd.
He said in a statement that the demands on his time made it impossible for him to hold dual responsibilities at Randgold and JCI.

"While I'll maintain a close association with Randgold, in which my family has a substantial investment, my direct involvement is no longer requried there, particularly as I have every confidence in its strong management team," Kebble said.
Randgold chairman Peter Flack said Kebble had been an important member of the management team that had transformed Randgold over the past three years.
Flack said that having almost completed the various acquisitions and transactions in the Randgold strategic plan, Kebble had effectively worked himself out of a job.
"With his characteristic creativity and energy, Brett made an invaluable contribution at Randgold. We shall miss him, but we understand his need for new challenges," Flack said in a statement.
